Use structured GitHub scopes in Turn account resolution (#160)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-5
  description: |-
    Carry structured GitHub {kind, name} scope through Channel Turn planning, approval, persistence, and execution.
    
    Account selection is exact configured repository route, then owning-organization route, then Owner-only dynamic discovery. Dynamic evidence is user-login match, active org membership, or matching GitHub App installation; write and destructive calls also need repository permission evidence. Public 200 is reachability only and never selects an account. Equal-authority accounts return a bounded ambiguity error.
    
    Durable plans persist an explicit account; auto does not survive. Execution provisions the planned account and structured scope without reselection. Credential-read remains for account-bound calls such as get_me. Legacy repository-only plans still decode safely.
